guideText.text: Antalya (Lara Beach) in Mediterranean is an exposed sandbar break that has inconsistent surf. Winter is the optimum time of year for surfing here. Offshore winds blow from the north and there is no shelter here from cross shore breezes. Waves more likely to be from local windswells than distant groundswells and the ideal wave direction is from the south southwest. The sandbar breaks offer lefts and rights. Even when the surf is up, crowds are unknown. Antalya (Lara Beach)

guideText.text: Stone-Tombs in Mediterranean is an exposed beach break. Winter is the best time of year for surfing here. Offshore winds are from the northwest and there is no shelter here from cross shore breezes. There is too little fetch for groundswells to form and the optimum wave angle is from the southeast. Waves at the beach break both left and right. Good surf at all stages of the tide. An uncrowded break, even when it is working. Stone-Tombs
